This PKGBUILD follows standard Arch Linux packaging practices. All three source files are legitimately pulled from the upstream GitHub repository (github.com/yairm210/Unciv): a JAR file, a PNG icon, and a zip archive containing Linux files. The package() function contains only standard installation operations - copying the shell script, desktop file, icon, and JAR to their respective locations in the package directory. No suspicious elements were found.

No obfuscated code, no unexpected network requests, no dangerous commands (eval, base64, curl, wget), and no arbitrary file operations outside the package directory. The dependencies listed (java-runtime, bash, xorg-xrandr) are appropriate for a Java-based game application. MD5 checksums are provided for all sources.
